chapter_title: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants: Dhoop se khana kaise banta hai?
big_question: Paudha dhoop ko khane mein kaise badalta hai, aur uski production kab tez ya dheemi padti hai?

pillars.title: Dhoop se khane tak ke saboot
pillars.line: Experiments se samjho ki paudhe ko kya chahiye aur oxygen kahan se aati hai.

pillars.title: Patte ki solar machinery
pillars.line: Chloroplast aur pigments ke andar light pakadne ka system dekho.

pillars.title: Light se ATP aur NADPH
pillars.line: Electrons aur protons ka flow chemical energy banata hai.

pillars.title: CO2 se sugar
pillars.line: Calvin cycle, C4 pathway aur photorespiration ka connection samjho.

pillars.title: Production ki speed kis ke haath?
pillars.line: Light, CO2, temperature aur paani se photosynthesis ki rate badalte dekho.

questions.question: Paudha khana khata nahi, toh hamara khana aakhir aata kahan se hai?
questions.hook: Apni thaali ki har cheez ka connection peeche trace karo—kahin na kahin ek hara paudha milta hai.

points.point: Life ko organism aur ecology ke level par, ya cells aur molecules ke physiology-biochemistry level par samajh sakte hain.
Photosynthesis, respiration aur growth mein molecular reactions, cell activity, poora paudha aur environment jude rehte hain.
Hare paudhe apna organic food banane wale autotrophs hain; unse food lene wale organisms heterotrophs hain.
Photosynthesis ek physico-chemical process hai jo light energy ko chemical energy mein badalkar food aur atmospheric oxygen ka mukhya aadhaar banta hai.

film.showing_moment: Thaali se food connections ulte chalte hain aur patte par sunlight organic food mein badalti dikhti hai.

game_stage.idea: Sunlight se paudhe aur phir consumers tak energy ka route jodo; sahi route par food supply chalti hai.

questions.question: Ek hi patte ke kuch hisse starch banayein aur kuch nahi—aisa kyun?
questions.hook: Patta light mein tha, phir bhi iodine test mein poora blue-black nahi hua.

points.point: Photosynthesis ke liye chlorophyll, light aur CO2 ki zaroorat ko controlled experiments se test karte hain.
Variegated leaf ke green parts aur partially covered leaf ke illuminated parts mein starch milna chlorophyll aur light ki zaroorat dikhata hai.
KOH CO2 absorb karta hai, isliye tube ke andar wala leaf part starch-negative aur air mein khula part starch-positive hota hai.

film.showing_moment: Iodine padte hi sirf green, illuminated aur CO2 paane wale leaf regions blue-black hote hain.

game_stage.idea: Leaf regions par cover aur KOH lagao, starch result predict karo aur iodine test chalao.

questions.question: Band jar mein bujhti candle ko mint plant kaise madad kar sakta hai?
questions.hook: Ek closed jar mein candle bujh jaati hai—plant jodne par air mein kya badalta hai?

points.point: Priestley ne 1770 mein air aur plants par experiments kiye aur 1774 mein oxygen discover ki.
Bell jar mein candle aur mouse air ko badalte hain; suitable light mein mint plant oxygen restore karke burning aur survival ko support karta hai.
Jar khole bina candle dobara jalana zaroori hai, warna fresh air experiment ka result badal degi.
Ingenhousz ne light-dark comparison aur aquatic plant bubbles se dikhaya ki sunlight mein green parts oxygen release karte hain.

film.showing_moment: Light milte hi aquatic plant ke green parts se oxygen bubbles nikalne lagte hain.

game_stage.idea: Jar ke liye plant, light aur sealed testing setup chuno; oxygen meter aur candle ka response dekho.

questions.question: Bacteria ki bheed bata sakti hai ki paudha kis rang ki light mein zyada kaam karta hai?
questions.hook: Rainbow ke neeche rakhe alga par bacteria har jagah barabar nahi rukte.

points.point: Sachs ne lagbhag 1854 mein glucose production, starch storage aur chloroplasts mein green pigment ka sambandh dikhaya.
Engelmann ke prism experiment mein Cladophora ke blue-red regions par aerobic bacteria jama hue, jo zyada oxygen production aur pehla action spectrum dikhata hai.
Early empirical equation CO2 + H2O —light→ [CH2O] + O2 mein [CH2O] carbohydrate ki general unit ko dikhata hai.

film.showing_moment: Spectrum alga par padta hai aur aerobic bacteria blue-red illuminated regions mein ikattha hote hain.

game_stage.idea: Prism colours ke saamne bacteria ki expected gathering place karo, phir oxygen release aur migration run karo.

questions.question: Paudhe ki nikli oxygen CO2 se aati hai ya paani se?
questions.hook: Dono raw materials mein oxygen hai—sirf equation dekhkar source kaise chunoge?

points.point: Van Niel ne photosynthesis ko light-driven reduction maana: 2H2A + CO2 → 2A + CH2O + H2O, jahan H2A suitable hydrogen donor hai.
Green plants water se oxygen banate hain, jabki H2S use karne wale sulphur bacteria sulphur ya sulphate bana sakte hain; isotope tracing ne water source confirm kiya.
Overall equation 6CO2 + 12H2O —light→ C6H12O6 + 6H2O + 6O2 multistep process dikhati hai; 12 waters consume aur 6 regenerate hone se net 6 waters use hote hain.

film.showing_moment: Labelled water ke oxygen atoms released O2 tak pahunchte hain, CO2 ke labelled atoms us route par nahi jaate.

game_stage.idea: Water aur CO2 ke labelled atoms ko products tak route karo; sahi mapping par equation balance hoti hai.

questions.question: Patte ke andar light pakadne aur sugar banane ki jagah alag kyun hai?
questions.hook: Ek chloroplast ke andar do departments hain—dono ka kaam ek jaisa nahi.

points.point: Leaves aur doosre green parts photosynthesise karte hain; mesophyll ke chloroplasts cell walls ke paas orientation badalkar suitable light paate hain.
Chloroplast mein outer-inner membranes, grana, stromal lamellae, stroma, ribosomes, starch granules aur lipid droplets ko locate karte hain.
Membranes ki light reactions ATP-NADPH banati hain aur stroma ki carbon reactions unse sugar-starch banati hain; dark reaction ka matlab darkness mein chalna nahi hai.
Recap mein CO2 ka stomata se leaf aur phir chloroplast ki sugar-making machinery tak route jodte hain.

film.showing_moment: Leaf ka zoom chloroplast mein pahunchta hai aur membrane se bane ATP-NADPH stroma ki sugar reactions ko chalu karte hain.

game_stage.idea: Chloroplast ke parts sahi jagah lagao aur light reaction se stroma tak supply connection banao.

questions.question: Hara patta chromatography mein peele-orange bands kyun deta hai?
questions.hook: Ek green leaf ka extract paper par chadhta hai aur ek rang kai rangon mein khul jaata hai.

points.point: Paper chromatography chlorophyll a ko blue-green, chlorophyll b ko yellow-green, xanthophylls ko yellow aur carotenoid pigments ko yellow-orange bands mein alag dikhati hai.
Pigments specific wavelengths absorb karte hain; chlorophyll a major photosynthetic pigment hai aur visible spectrum mein alag colours ki wavelengths alag hoti hain.
Lambe darkness exposure mein chlorophyll kam hone par relatively stable yellow carotenoid pigments leaf ko pale ya yellow dikhate hain.
Shade-adapted leaves aksar zyada chlorophyll ke kaaran darker green hoti hain, jisse kam light capture karne mein madad milti hai.

film.showing_moment: Green extract paper par alag coloured pigment bands mein separate hota hai.

game_stage.idea: Separated bands ko pigment identities se jodo; sahi pigments milne par leaf ka combined colour dobara banta hai.

questions.question: Green leaf blue aur red light mein zyada photosynthesis kyun karta hai?
questions.hook: Leaf hara dikhta hai, lekin uski production graph green region mein sabse unchi nahi hoti.

points.point: Absorption spectrum pigment ka light absorption aur action spectrum photosynthesis ki rate dikhata hai; blue-red peaks milti hain par exact overlap nahi hota.
Chlorophyll b, xanthophylls aur carotenoids extra wavelengths ki energy chlorophyll a ko dete hain aur photo-oxidation se protection bhi dete hain.
Sirf accessory pigments, bina reaction-centre chlorophyll a ke, normal photosynthetic photochemistry nahi chala sakte.

film.showing_moment: Wavelength sweep ke saath absorption aur photosynthesis curves banti hain aur accessory pigments gap ko bharte hain.

game_stage.idea: Light ka colour badlo aur accessory pigments on-off karo; absorbed energy aur photosynthesis output badalte dekho.

questions.question: Sauon pigment molecules ek reaction centre ko energy kaise pahunchate hain?
questions.hook: Light kisi aur pigment par girti hai, lekin electron launch ek special chlorophyll se hota hai.

points.point: Light reaction mein light absorption, water splitting, oxygen release aur ATP-NADPH formation shamil hain.
Protein-bound pigments ki antenna light energy reaction-centre chlorophyll a tak funnel karti hai; PSI-PSII ke naam discovery order par hain, working order par nahi.
PSI ka reaction centre P700, 700 nm par aur PSII ka P680, 680 nm par maximum absorb karta hai.

film.showing_moment: Antenna par gira photon energy transfer ke through reaction centre tak pahunchkar electron excite karta hai.

game_stage.idea: Antenna, reaction centre aur acceptor jodo; sahi assembly par photon electron launch karta hai.

questions.question: Electron ko sugar-making power dene ke liye do baar light ka push kyun chahiye?
questions.hook: Ek baar excite hua electron raste mein energy chhodta hai—phir usko dobara lift milti hai.

points.point: PSII ka P680 light se electron excite karta hai; acceptor se cytochrome-containing electron transport chain electron ko PSI tak pahunchati hai, use khatam nahi karti.
PSI par 700 nm light electron ko dobara excite karti hai aur final transfer NADP+ ko NADPH mein reduce karta hai.
Carriers ko redox-potential scale par rakhne se do light-driven lifts aur beech ka downhill transfer Z-scheme banate hain; final acceptor NADP+ hai.

film.showing_moment: Electron PSII aur PSI par do light lifts leta hua Z-shaped route se NADP+ tak pahunchta hai.

game_stage.idea: PSII se NADP+ tak carriers aur do photon boosts lagao; incomplete route par NADPH production rukti hai.

questions.question: PSII apne electrons bhejta rahe toh uska stock khatam kyun nahi hota?
questions.hook: Electron nikal gaya—ab khaali reaction centre ko refill kaun karega?

points.point: Water splitting PSII ke lost electrons replace karti hai aur PSII se aaye electrons PSI ki kami poori karte hain.
Lumen-facing PSII water-splitting complex mein 2H2O → 4H+ + O2 + 4e− hota hai; protons aur oxygen lumen side par release hote hain.

film.showing_moment: Do water molecules split hote hain aur electrons PSII refill karte hue H+ aur O2 ko lumen mein chhodte hain.

game_stage.idea: Water-splitting products ko PSII, lumen aur oxygen outlet tak bhejo; sahi routing electron supply dobara chalu karti hai.

questions.question: Electron kab seedha NADPH banata hai aur kab ghoomkar wapas aa jaata hai?
questions.hook: Ek route par ATP aur NADPH dono milte hain, doosre par sirf ATP.

points.point: ATP bond energy carry karta hai; ADP aur inorganic phosphate se ATP banana phosphorylation aur light ki madad se banana photophosphorylation hai.
Non-cyclic flow mein PSII phir PSI kaam karte hain aur water-to-NADP+ route ATP, NADPH aur oxygen deta hai.
Cyclic flow mein PSI electron ETC se wapas leta hai aur sirf ATP banta hai; stroma lamellae mein PSII aur NADP reductase nahi hote, aur beyond-680 nm light is flow ko favour karti hai.
Recap mein cyclic aur non-cyclic routes ko photosystems, electron destination, water splitting aur products se compare karte hain.

film.showing_moment: Electron route ka switch NADP+ ki taraf jaane ke bajay PSI par loop close karta hai aur output sirf ATP reh jaata hai.

game_stage.idea: Electron circuit ko open route ya closed loop banao; product counters route ke mutabik badlein.

questions.question: Chloroplast ke andar H+ ka jamav kaise banta hai?
questions.hook: Thylakoid ki ek side acidic hoti jaati hai, doosri side se protons gaayab hote jaate hain.

points.point: Chemiosmosis mein ATP synthesis membrane ke proton gradient se judi hai; chloroplast mein H+ lumen mein, mitochondria mein intermembrane space mein jama hote hain.
Water splitting lumen ke andar H+ add karke gradient badhati hai.
Electron transport ka H-carrier stroma se proton leta aur lumen side par chhodta hai.
Stroma-side NADP reductase reduction ke liye H+ use karti hai, isliye stroma mein H+ ghatte aur lumen ka pH girta hai.

film.showing_moment: Teen contributions ke saath lumen ka H+ counter badhta, stroma ka ghatta aur lumen pH neeche jaata hai.

game_stage.idea: Water splitting, H-carrier aur NADP reduction ko sahi side connect karo; resulting proton gradient screen par banao.

questions.question: Jama hue protons wapas niklein toh ATP kaise ban jaata hai?
questions.hook: Membrane mein ek specific exit khulte hi stored gradient usable energy banne lagta hai.

points.point: ATP synthase ka membrane-embedded CF0 proton channel hai aur CF1 stroma-facing catalytic part hai.
H+ ka lumen se stroma facilitated diffusion CF1 mein conformational change chalaakar ATP synthesis karwata hai.
Chemiosmosis ko intact membrane, proton pump, proton gradient aur ATP synthase chahiye; uncontrolled leak gradient ki energy waste karta hai.
Bane hue ATP aur NADPH stroma mein CO2 fixation aur sugar synthesis ko supply hote hain.

film.showing_moment: H+ CF0 se stroma mein lautte hain aur CF1 shape badalkar ADP-Pi se ATP banata hai.

game_stage.idea: Membrane mein CF0 aur stroma side CF1 lagao; gradient release karke ATP banao, leak lagane par output girta dekho.

questions.question: Light band karte hi sugar banana turant kyun nahi rukta?
questions.hook: Switch off ho gaya, lekin chloroplast ki sugar line kuch der aur chalti hai.

points.point: Oxygen diffuse hokar bahar nikalti hai; biosynthetic phase ATP-NADPH par dependent hai, isliye light off hone ke baad supply khatam hone tak chal sakti hai.
Calvin ke 14C-labelled CO2 wale algal studies ne pehla stable fixation product 3-carbon PGA aur cyclic biosynthetic pathway identify kiya.

April 1911 Minnesota mein janme chemist Calvin ne Berkeley mein Bassham ke saath beneficial isotope tracing ki; organised electron-transfer idea aur carbon-assimilation mapping ke liye 1961 Nobel mila.
Photosynthesis ki energy-conversion understanding renewable resources aur solar-energy research ko inspire karti hai.
First stable fixation product 3-carbon PGA ho toh C3 aur 4-carbon OAA ho toh C4 pathway kehte hain.

film.showing_moment: Light off hone ke baad ATP-NADPH stock ghatta hai aur stock khatam hote hi sugar production rukti hai.

game_stage.idea: Light off-on schedule set karo aur predict karo sugar line kab rukegi; energy-stock meters ke saath run dekho.

questions.question: CO2 ka ek carbon judta hai toh 5-carbon acceptor se 3-carbon product kaise banta hai?
questions.hook: 5 + 1 ka answer 3 nahi—raaz product molecules ki ginti mein hai.

points.point: Primary CO2 acceptor guessed 2-carbon molecule nahi, balki 5-carbon ketose sugar RuBP hai.
Calvin cycle C3 aur C4 dono plants mein hota hai aur carboxylation, reduction, regeneration se RuBP dobara banata hai.
RuBisCO-catalysed carboxylation mein RuBP aur CO2 se do 3-PGA bante hain; enzyme ki oxygenase activity bhi hai.
Cycle diagram mein CO2 entry, ATP-NADPH input, triose-phosphate output, sucrose-starch branch aur RuBP regeneration ko ek loop mein track karte hain.
Reduction mein har fixed CO2 par 2 ATP aur 2 NADPH use hote hain; ek glucose equivalent ke liye 6 CO2 aur 6 turns chahiye.
Regeneration mein har CO2 ke hisaab se 1 ATP lagakar RuBP wapas banta hai, taaki cycle ruk na jaaye.

film.showing_moment: 5-carbon RuBP mein CO2 judta hai, do 3-PGA bante hain aur carbon flow loop ghoomkar RuBP regenerate karta hai.

game_stage.idea: Carbon-count tiles se carboxylation, reduction aur regeneration jodo; sahi carbon balance par cycle repeat hota hai.

questions.question: Ek glucose banane ka ATP-NADPH bill kitna aata hai?
questions.hook: Factory ko dono energy currencies barabar quantity mein nahi chahiye.

points.point: Har CO2 fixation ka total bill 3 ATP aur 2 NADPH hai; extra ATP ki demand cyclic photophosphorylation se poori ho sakti hai.
Ek glucose ke liye 6 CO2, 18 ATP aur 12 NADPH lagte hain; corresponding 18 ADP aur 12 NADP+ dobara light reactions ko milte hain.

film.showing_moment: Chhah cycle turns ke saath 18 ATP aur 12 NADPH tokens kharch hote hain aur ek glucose-equivalent output milta hai.

game_stage.idea: Cycle ko ATP-NADPH tokens supply karo; galat ratio par production rukti hai aur cyclic route se ATP top-up karna padta hai.

questions.question: Maize ke patte ko andar se dekhein toh uski special arrangement kya batati hai?
questions.hook: Bahar se hara patta aam lagta hai, andar vascular bundle ke around ek wreath milta hai.

points.point: Dry tropical adaptation wale C4 plants OAA se shuru karke Calvin cycle se sugar banate hain aur high light-temperature mein achchi productivity dikhate hain.
Kranz anatomy mein vascular bundles ke around large chloroplast-rich bundle sheath cells ki wreath hoti hai, jinki thick walls aur absent intercellular spaces gas leakage kam karte hain.
External appearance se C3-C4 reliably identify nahi hote; maize-sorghum jaise leaves ke sections mein specialised Kranz arrangement ko compare karte hain, sirf bundle sheath ki presence ko nahi.

film.showing_moment: Leaf section ka zoom vascular bundle ke around chloroplast-rich bundle sheath ki ring reveal karta hai.

game_stage.idea: Vascular bundle, bundle sheath aur mesophyll arrange karo; correct Kranz layout par CO2-retaining compartment highlight hota hai.

questions.question: C4 paudha CO2 ko ek cell se doosre cell tak parcel kyun karta hai?
questions.hook: CO2 seedha Calvin cycle mein jaane ke bajay pehle four-carbon parcel mein pack hoti hai.

points.point: Hatch-Slack cycle mein mesophyll ka 3-carbon PEP, PEPcase ki madad se CO2 fix karke OAA banata hai; yahan RuBisCO absent hota hai.
OAA se malate ya aspartate bante hain, jo bundle sheath mein jaakar CO2 aur 3-carbon compound release karte hain.
3-carbon compound mesophyll lautkar PEP regenerate karta hai aur released CO2 bundle sheath ke RuBisCO-Calvin cycle mein jaati hai; bundle sheath mein PEPcase nahi hota.
C3 mein Calvin cycle mesophyll mein, jabki C4 mein initial fixation mesophyll aur Calvin cycle bundle sheath mein hota hai.

film.showing_moment: Four-carbon parcel mesophyll se bundle sheath pahunchkar CO2 release karta hai aur three-carbon carrier wapas laut jaata hai.

game_stage.idea: PEP, OAA, C4 acids aur returning C3 compound ko dono cell types ke beech route karo; correct shuttle Calvin cycle ko CO2 deti hai.

questions.question: RuBisCO oxygen pakad le toh sugar production ko nuksaan kyun hota hai?
questions.hook: Wahi enzyme jo CO2 fix karta hai, galat gas pakadkar energy kharch karwa sakta hai.

points.point: Duniya ka most abundant enzyme RuBisCO CO2 aur O2 dono bind karta hai; competitive binding relative gas concentrations par depend karti hai aur comparable concentrations par CO2 ko preference hoti hai.
Oxygenation mein RuBP se ek 3-PGA aur 2-carbon phosphoglycolate bante hain; photorespiration ATP use aur CO2 release karti hai, sugar, ATP ya NADPH produce nahi karti.
C4 acids bundle sheath mein CO2 concentrate karke RuBisCO ki oxygenase activity minimise karte hain, isliye negligible photorespiration ke saath productivity aur heat tolerance better hoti hai.

film.showing_moment: RuBisCO ke paas CO2 badhne par O2 binding aur phosphoglycolate formation ghatkar carboxylation badhti hai.

game_stage.idea: RuBisCO ke aas-paas CO2:O2 ratio badlo; sugar flow, ATP waste aur CO2 loss ka live response dekho.

questions.question: Do hare paudhon mein C3 aur C4 ka farq ek saath kaise pakdein?
questions.hook: Dono sugar banate hain, lekin carbon acceptor, cells aur hot-day performance alag hain.

points.point: Recap: C3 mein ek mesophyll cell type initial fixation aur Calvin cycle karta hai; C4 mein mesophyll aur bundle sheath milkar do-cell system banate hain.
Recap: C3 ka acceptor RuBP-5C aur product PGA-3C; C4 ka initial acceptor PEP-3C aur product OAA-4C hai.
Recap: Dono pathways RuBisCO use karte hain; C4 mein initial PEPcase mesophyll aur RuBisCO bundle sheath mein kaam karte hain.
High light aur low CO2 mein C3 ki photorespiratory loss badh sakti hai, high CO2 par ghat sakti hai; C4 mein yeh negligible rehti hai aur high-light fixation behtar hoti hai.
Typical comparison mein C3 ka temperature optimum 20–25°C aur C4 ka 30–40°C hota hai; leaf sections aur maize-sorghum jaise examples se identification revise karte hain.

film.showing_moment: Do leaf systems ke saamne same hot, bright conditions aati hain aur unke carbon routes aur output alag respond karte hain.

game_stage.idea: Cell, enzyme, carbon-count aur anatomy parts se C3-C4 systems banao; phir high-light scenario run karke output compare karo.

questions.question: Light aur CO2 dono mil rahe hon, phir bhi paudha slow kyun pad sakta hai?
questions.hook: Factory ke saare departments ready hain, lekin ek missing condition poori line rok deti hai.

points.point: Yield se judi photosynthetic rate par leaf number-size-age-orientation, mesophyll, chloroplasts, internal CO2 aur chlorophyll asar karte hain; yeh genetics aur growth par depend hain.
External light, temperature, CO2 aur water ek saath affect karte hain, lekin suboptimal factor aksar rate ko limit karta hai.
Blackman ke 1905 law ke mutabik limiting factor ko improve karne se rate badhti hai; bahut low temperature par extra light-CO2 ka fayda nahi milta.

film.showing_moment: Light aur CO2 badhane par output same rehta hai, lekin limiting temperature improve hote hi production tez hoti hai.

game_stage.idea: Limited upgrades se greenhouse controls badlo; sirf current bottleneck sudharne par yield meter badhe.

questions.question: Zyada dhoop dene se photosynthesis hamesha zyada kyun nahi hoti?
questions.hook: Light badhti jaati hai, lekin graph pehle chadhta hai, phir flat aur kabhi neeche ho jaata hai.

points.point: Light quality, intensity aur exposure duration alag factors hain, inhe ek hi cheez nahi samajhna chahiye.
Low light par fixation lagbhag linearly badhti hai; lagbhag 10% full sunlight par saturation aa sakti hai aur phir doosre factors limiting hote hain.
Bahut excessive light chlorophyll breakdown karwaakar photosynthesis ghata sakti hai; shade aur dense forests mein light limitation zyada relevant hai.
Light-response graph mein rising region A light limitation, plateau C saturation aur zero-light D net respiratory loss ko dikhate hain; bend B par limitation shift samajhte hain.

film.showing_moment: Light slider badhne par rate curve rise karti, plateau hoti aur excessive exposure par pigment damage ke saath girti hai.

game_stage.idea: Light intensity control karke target fixation rate paao; plateau par doosra limiting factor badlo aur excessive light se damage dekho.

questions.question: Greenhouse mein extra CO2 dene se tomatoes ki yield kab badhegi?
questions.hook: CO2 badhao, par dim light mein crop output phir bhi nahi badhta.

points.point: Is comparison ke atmospheric reference 0.03–0.04% CO2 par CO2 major limiting factor hai; lagbhag 0.05% tak enrichment fixation badha sakta hai, prolonged excess harmful ho sakta hai.
Low light mein C3-C4 extra CO2 ka kam response dete hain; high light mein C4 lagbhag 360 µL/L aur C3 450 µL/L se aage saturation dikhata hai.
C3 crops tomato aur bell pepper ko suitable light ke saath CO2-enriched greenhouse mein rakhne se photosynthesis aur yield badh sakti hai.

film.showing_moment: Same CO2 enrichment dim light mein little change deta hai, bright light mein C3 crop ka output badhata hai.

game_stage.idea: C3-C4 greenhouse mein light aur CO2 controls badlo; saturation aur yield ko dekhkar useful enrichment set karo.

questions.question: Garmi aur paani ki kami patte ki food factory ko alag tareeke se kaise rokti hain?
questions.hook: Paani reaction ka raw material hai, lekin drought mein pehla bada brake aksar CO2 entry par lagta hai.

points.point: Enzyme-driven carbon reactions temperature se strongly affect hoti hain; light reactions comparatively kam sensitive hain aur C4 ka optimum C3 se higher hota hai.
Temperature optimum habitat adaptation par depend karta hai; tropical plants ka optimum temperate plants se generally higher hota hai.
Water stress stomata close karke CO2 supply ghatata hai aur wilting se exposed leaf area aur metabolic activity bhi kam hoti hai.

film.showing_moment: Water stress badhne par stomata band hote hain, CO2 entry ghatati hai aur leaf wilt hone ke saath sugar output girta hai.

game_stage.idea: Tropical ya temperate plant ke liye temperature aur watering choose karo; stomata, leaf shape aur photosynthetic output ka response run karo.
